```{r}
library(stringi)
# Filter the selected columns for years available in panel_data_indice
years_panel <- unique(panel_data_indice$Year)
selected_filtered <- selected_columns %>%
    filter(ano %in% years_panel)

panel_data_indice$Year <- as.character(panel_data_indice$Year)
# Ensure column names and data types are consistent before merging
selected_filtered_normalized <- selected_filtered %>%
    rename(
        "Year" = ano,
        'NM_MUNICIPIO' = nome_do_municipio,
        'SG_UF' = uf
    ) %>%
    mutate(
        Year = as.character(Year),
        NM_MUNICIPIO_norm = NM_MUNICIPIO %>%
           stri_trans_general( "Latin-ASCII") %>%
           str_replace_all("['\\-]", " ") %>%      # Remove hyphens and apostrophes
           str_to_upper() %>%                     # Convert to uppercase
           str_trim(),
        SG_UF = as.character(SG_UF)
    )
panel_data_indice_normalized <- panel_data_indice %>%
  mutate(NM_MUNICIPIO_norm = NM_MUNICIPIO %>%
           stri_trans_general("Latin-ASCII") %>%
           str_replace_all("['\\-]", " ") %>%      # Remove hyphens and apostrophes
           str_to_upper() %>%                     # Convert to uppercase
           str_trim())


```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(fuzzyjoin)
library(stringdist)

# For illustration, assume:
# left_df   = panel_data_indice_normalized
# right_df  = selected_filtered_normalized

# Step 0: If not already unique, add an identifier to the left data
left_df <- panel_data_indice_normalized %>% mutate(row_id = row_number())

# ------------------------------
# Step 1. Exact join on state, municipality, and year
exact_matches <- left_df %>%
  inner_join(
    selected_filtered_normalized,
    by = c("SG_UF", "NM_MUNICIPIO_norm", "Year")
  )

# ------------------------------
# Step 2. For rows with no exact match, perform a fuzzy join on NM_MUNICIPIO
# but require the same sg_uf and year.
# First, identify left_df rows that did not match exactly:
non_exact_left <- left_df %>%
  anti_join(exact_matches, by = "row_id")

# Now, use fuzzy_left_join on the non-matching rows.
# Here we match exactly on sg_uf and year, and use a fuzzy match on NM_MUNICIPIO.
# Adjust the threshold (here, < 0.1) as appropriate for your data.
fuzzy_matches <- non_exact_left %>%
  fuzzy_left_join(
    selected_filtered_normalized,
    by = c("SG_UF" = "SG_UF",
           "Year"  = "Year",
           "NM_MUNICIPIO_norm" = "NM_MUNICIPIO_norm"),
    match_fun = list(`==`, `==`, function(x, y) stringdist(x, y, method = "jw") < 0.1)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pib))

# ------------------------------
# Step 3. Combine the exact and fuzzy matches.
# Depending on your needs, you might want to prefer exact matches over fuzzy ones if both exist.
final_join <- bind_rows(
  exact_matches,
  fuzzy_matches
) 
```

```{r}
write.csv(final_join, "./dados_base_estudo.csv")
```

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(AER)

# Load base data, dropping the index column and converting Year to integer
dados_base_estudo <- readr::read_csv("dados_base_estudo.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(-`...1`) |>
  mutate(Year = as.integer(Year))

# Load municipal production data (skip the title row, use ';' delimiter, comma decimals)
producao_muni <- readr::read_delim(
  "dados agricolas/producao_valor_total_muni.csv",
  delim = ";",
  skip = 1,                       # skip the "Valor da produção - total" line
  locale = locale(decimal_mark = ","),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  rename(
    SG_UF = Sigla,
    codigo_do_municipio = `Código`,
    municipio = `Município`
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^\\d{4}$"),   # year columns like 1990, 1991...
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "producao_valor_total_bruto"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Year = as.integer(Year),
    codigo_do_municipio = as.integer(codigo_do_municipio)
  )

# Load national (Brazil) production data, skip title row
producao_br <- readr::read_delim(
  "dados agricolas/producao_valor_total_br.csv",
  delim = ",",
  skip = 1,
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  rename(
    SG_UF = Sigla,
    codigo_pais = `Código`,
    pais = Brasil
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = matches("^\\d{4}$"),
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "shock"
  ) |>
  mutate(Year = as.integer(Year))

# Choose a baseline year for shares (e.g., 2002)
baseline_year <- 2000
total_baseline <- producao_muni |>
  filter(Year == baseline_year) |>
  summarise(total = sum(producao_valor_total_bruto, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  pull(total)

shares <- producao_muni |>
  filter(Year == baseline_year) |>
  mutate(share = producao_valor_total_bruto / total_baseline) |>
  select(codigo_do_municipio, share)

# Construct the shift-share instrument by combining the baseline shares and national shocks
instrument <- shares |>
  tidyr::crossing(producao_br) |>
  transmute(
    codigo_do_municipio,
    Year,
    shift_share_iv = share * shock
  )

# Merge everything together on municipality code and year
dados_iv <- dados_base_estudo |>
  left_join(producao_muni, by = c("codigo_do_municipio", "Year")) |>
  left_join(instrument,  by = c("codigo_do_municipio", "Year"))


dados_iv <- dados_iv %>%
        mutate(producao_milhoes = producao_valor_total_bruto / 1e6,
        index_centrao_pct = index_centrao * 100,
        shift_share_iv = shift_share_iv / 1e6)  
  


```



```{r}

# Run IV regression: instrumenting municipal production with the shift-share instrument
iv_model <- AER::ivreg(
  index_centrao_pct ~ producao_milhoes | shift_share_iv,
  data = dados_iv
)

# View results
summary(iv_model)
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# --- Population estimates (populacao.csv) ---
populacao <- readr::read_csv("populacao.csv", skip = 1, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(-starts_with("Unnamed")) %>%                    # drop the blank column
  rename(
    SG_UF = Sigla,
    codigo_do_municipio = `Código`,
    municipio = `Município`
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(SG_UF, codigo_do_municipio, municipio),
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "populacao"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.numeric(Year),
    codigo_do_municipio = as.numeric(codigo_do_municipio)
  )

# --- Census population (populacao_censo.csv) ---
populacao_censo <- readr::read_csv("populacao_censo.csv", skip = 1, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(-starts_with("Unnamed")) %>%
  rename(
    SG_UF = Sigla,
    codigo_do_municipio = `Código`,
    municipio = `Município`
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(SG_UF, codigo_do_municipio, municipio),
    names_to = "Year",
    values_to = "populacao_censo"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.numeric(Year),
    codigo_do_municipio = as.numeric(codigo_do_municipio)
  )

# --- Analfabetismo rates (regressPanel_dados.csv) ---
analfabetismo <- readr::read_csv("regressPanel_dados.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  rename(
    codigo_do_municipio = ibge,
    taxa_analfabetismo = taxa_analfabetismo
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    codigo_do_municipio = as.numeric(codigo_do_municipio),
    Year = as.numeric(Year)
  ) %>%
  select(codigo_do_municipio, Year, taxa_analfabetismo)

# --- Combine the datasets with your panel (assumes you have a data frame `dados_iv` or similar) ---
dados_iv <- dados_iv %>%
  left_join(populacao,      by = c("codigo_do_municipio", "Year")) %>%
  left_join(populacao_censo, by = c("codigo_do_municipio", "Year")) %>%
  left_join(analfabetismo,  by = c("codigo_do_municipio", "Year"))

# Now `dados_iv` contains the additional variables:
# - `populacao`   : intercensal population estimates (various years)
# - `populacao_censo` : census population counts (2007, 2010, 2022)
# - `taxa_analfabetismo` : illiteracy rate from regressPanel_dados.csv


write.csv(dados_iv, "./dados_iv.csv")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plm)
library(AER)       # for iv diagnostics
library(lmtest)    # for coeftest
library(sandwich)  # for

# === 1. Read and clean the data ===

# Read the raw data
dados_iv <- readr::read_csv("dados_iv.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# Drop columns that contain only NAs and extraneous index columns
dados_iv_clean <- dados_iv %>%
  select(where(~ !all(is.na(.)))) %>%
  select(-matches("^\\.\\.\\..*")) %>%            # remove columns like ...1
  mutate(
    codigo_do_municipio = as.numeric(codigo_do_municipio),
    Year = as.integer(Year)
  )

# === 2. Deduplicate and summarise municipality–year observations ===

# Collapse duplicates by taking the first value for most variables and averaging
# `taxa_analfabetismo` and `populacao` if duplicates exist.
dados_panel <- dados_iv_clean %>%
  group_by(codigo_do_municipio, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    UF = first(SG_UF.x),
    index_centrao        = first(index_centrao),
    producao_valor_total_bruto = first(producao_valor_total_bruto),
    populacao            = mean(populacao, na.rm = TRUE),
    taxa_analfabetismo   = mean(taxa_analfabetismo, na.rm = TRUE),
    vab_pub              = first(vab_pub),
    vab_total            = first(vab_total),
    vab_agro             = first(vab_agro),
    vab_ind             = first(vab_ind),
    vab_serv             = first(vab_serv),
    shift_share_iv       = first(shift_share_iv),
    pib_per_capita       = first(pib_per_capita),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Create the share of public GDP
  mutate(# compute shares of each sector in total GDP
    share_GDP_agro = vab_agro / vab_total,
    share_GDP_ind  = vab_ind  / vab_total,
    share_GDP_serv = vab_serv / vab_total,
    share_GDP_pub  = vab_pub  / vab_total,
    share_GDP_other = 1 - (share_GDP_agro + share_GDP_ind + share_GDP_serv + share_GDP_pub),
    
    # Herfindahl–Hirschman index: sum of squared shares
    hhi_sectors = share_GDP_agro^2 + share_GDP_ind^2 + 
                  share_GDP_serv^2 + share_GDP_pub^2 + share_GDP_other^2,
    
    # Alternatively, a diversification index scaled between 0 and 1:
    diversification_index = 1 - hhi_sectors)

# === 3. Rescale variables for interpretability ===

dados_panel <- dados_panel %>%
  mutate(
    producao_milhoes       = producao_valor_total_bruto / 1e6,
    shift_share_iv_milhoes = shift_share_iv / 1e6,
    index_centrao_pct      = index_centrao * 100,
    ln_pop = log(populacao)
  )


```

```{r}
# === 4. Two-way fixed-effects model (no instrument) ===

fe_model <- plm::plm(
  index_centrao_pct ~ producao_milhoes + ln_pop + taxa_analfabetismo + share_GDP_pub + diversification_index + pib_per_capita + share_GDP_ind,
  data  = dados_panel,
  index = c("codigo_do_municipio", "Year"),
  model = "within",
  effect = "twoways"
)
summary(fe_model)
```


```{r}
# === 5. Two-way fixed-effects IV model ===
# Instrument producao_milhoes with the rescaled shift-share instrument.
fe_iv_model <- plm::plm(
  index_centrao_pct ~ producao_milhoes + ln_pop + taxa_analfabetismo + diversification_index + pib_per_capita |
                      shift_share_iv_milhoes + ln_pop + taxa_analfabetismo + diversification_index + pib_per_capita,
  data  = dados_panel,
  index = c("codigo_do_municipio", "Year"),
  model = "within",
  effect = "twoways"
)
summary(fe_iv_model)
```



```{r}
# === 6. Cluster-robust standard errors (cluster at municipality level) ===

cluster_se <- vcovHC(fe_iv_model, type = "HC1", cluster = "group")
coeftest(fe_iv_model, vcov = cluster_se)
```


```{r}
# === 7. First-stage diagnostics using ivreg ===
# Add factor fixed effects for a pooled IV regression to get first-stage F-statistic.
dados_panel_ffx <- dados_panel %>%
  mutate(
    year_factor = factor(Year)
  )

iv_pooled <- AER::ivreg(
  index_centrao_pct ~ producao_milhoes + ln_pop + taxa_analfabetismo + diversification_index + pib_per_capita +
                      year_factor+ share_GDP_pub
                    | shift_share_iv_milhoes + ln_pop + taxa_analfabetismo  + diversification_index + pib_per_capita +
                      year_factor+ share_GDP_pub,
  data = dados_panel_ffx
)

# Show diagnostics: the "Weak instruments" test reports the first-stage F-statistic.
summary(iv_pooled, diagnostics = TRUE)


```

# Divided Instrument

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(AER)

# --- 1. Construct baseline shares from the 2000 municipal data ---

baseline <- read_csv("dados agricolas/valor_indiv_muni_2000.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  # Drop unnamed columns created from trailing commas (e.g. ...7)
  select(-matches("^Unnamed|^\\.\\.\\.")) %>%
  transmute(
    codigo_do_municipio = as.integer(`Código`),
    algodao  = as.numeric(`Produção - algodão - herbáceo (caroço) (2000)`),
    milho    = as.numeric(`Produção - milho (2000)`),
    soja     = as.numeric(`Produção - soja (2000)`)
  )

# Totals for each crop (all positive, so no need for if_else)
total_algodao <- sum(baseline$algodao, na.rm = TRUE)
total_milho   <- sum(baseline$milho,   na.rm = TRUE)
total_soja    <- sum(baseline$soja,    na.rm = TRUE)

# Shares for each municipality and crop
baseline <- baseline %>%
  mutate(
    share_algodao = algodao / total_algodao,
    share_milho   = milho   / total_milho,
    share_soja    = soja    / total_soja
  ) %>%
  select(codigo_do_municipio, share_algodao, share_milho, share_soja)

# --- 2. Read national production series for each crop ---

read_national <- function(file, varname) {
  read_csv(file, skip = 1, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    select(-matches("^Unnamed|^\\.\\.\\.")) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -c(Sigla, Código, Brasil),
      names_to  = "Year",
      values_to = varname
    ) %>%
    mutate(Year = as.integer(Year))
}

alg_br   <- read_national("dados agricolas/alg_valor_br.csv",   "shock_algodao")
milho_br <- read_national("dados agricolas/milho_valor_br.csv", "shock_milho")
soja_br  <- read_national("dados agricolas/soja_valor_br.csv",  "shock_soja")

# Combine national shocks into a single data frame keyed by Year
shocks <- alg_br %>%
  select(Year, shock_algodao) %>%
  full_join(milho_br %>% select(Year, shock_milho), by = "Year") %>%
  full_join(soja_br  %>% select(Year, shock_soja),  by = "Year")

# --- 3. Cross‑join shares with shocks and build the instrument ---
# Each row is a municipality–year combination
instrument <- tidyr::crossing(baseline, shocks) %>%
  mutate(
    shift_share_iv_new = share_algodao * shock_algodao +
                         share_milho   * shock_milho   +
                         share_soja    * shock_soja,
    # Rescale to match 'producao_milhoes' (divide by 1e6 if needed)
    shift_share_iv_new_milhoes = shift_share_iv_new / 1e6
  ) %>%
  select(codigo_do_municipio, Year, shift_share_iv_new_milhoes)

# --- 4. Merge the new instrument into your panel data ---
# Replace 'dados_panel' with the name of your panel data frame
dados_panel_final <- dados_panel_ffx %>%
  left_join(instrument, by = c("codigo_do_municipio", "Year"))

```

## Mais produtos 2001
```{r}
# --- Packages
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(AER)
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)

# ---------- A) BASELINE SHARES (within-municipality weights) ----------
baseline <- read_csv("dados agricolas/valor_indiv_muni_2001.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  select(-matches("^Unnamed|^\\.\\.\\.")) %>%
  transmute(
    codigo_do_municipio = as.integer(`Código`),
    algodao  = as.numeric(`Produção - algodão - herbáceo (caroço) (2001)`),
    milho    = as.numeric(`Produção - milho (2001)`),
    soja     = as.numeric(`Produção - soja (2001)`),
    laranja  = as.numeric(`Produção - laranja (2001)`),
    cafe     = as.numeric(`Produção - café (2001)`),
    mandioca = as.numeric(`Produção - mandioca (2001)`),
    arroz    = as.numeric(`Produção - arroz (2001)`),
    cana     = as.numeric(`Produção - cana-de-açúcar (2001)`)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::replace_na(list(algodao = 0, milho = 0, soja = 0, laranja = 0,
                         cafe = 0, mandioca = 0, arroz = 0, cana = 0)) %>%
  mutate(total_agro = algodao + milho + soja + laranja + cafe + mandioca + arroz + cana)

baseline_shares <- baseline %>%
  mutate(across(algodao:cana,
                ~ if_else(total_agro > 0, .x / total_agro, 0),
                .names = "w_{.col}")) %>%
  select(codigo_do_municipio, starts_with("w_"))

# ---------- B) NATIONAL PRICE SHOCKS (log deviations from baseline year) ----------
read_price_shocks <- function(file_path, baseline_year = 2002) {
  df <- read_delim(file_path,
                   delim = ";", skip = 3, col_names = TRUE, trim_ws = TRUE,
                   locale = locale(decimal_mark = ","), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    select(1:2) |>
    rename(Year = 1, price_BR = 2) |>
    mutate(Year = as.integer(Year),
           price_BR = as.numeric(price_BR)) |>
    filter(!is.na(Year))

  base_p <- if (baseline_year %in% df$Year) df$price_BR[df$Year == baseline_year] else df$price_BR[1]
  df |>
    mutate(log_shock = log(price_BR / base_p)) |>
    select(Year, log_shock)
}

alg_br      <- read_price_shocks("dados agricolas/precos/cepea-algodao.csv")  %>% rename(shock_algodao  = log_shock)
milho_br    <- read_price_shocks("dados agricolas/precos/cepea-milho.csv")    %>% rename(shock_milho    = log_shock)
soja_br     <- read_price_shocks("dados agricolas/precos/cepea-soja.csv")     %>% rename(shock_soja     = log_shock)
laranja_br  <- read_price_shocks("dados agricolas/precos/cepea-laranja.csv")  %>% rename(shock_laranja  = log_shock)
cafe_br     <- read_price_shocks("dados agricolas/precos/cepea-cafe.csv")     %>% rename(shock_cafe     = log_shock)
mandioca_br <- read_price_shocks("dados agricolas/precos/cepea-mandioca.csv") %>% rename(shock_mandioca = log_shock)
arroz_br    <- read_price_shocks("dados agricolas/precos/cepea-arroz.csv")    %>% rename(shock_arroz    = log_shock)
cana_br     <- read_price_shocks("dados agricolas/precos/cepea-cana.csv")     %>% rename(shock_cana     = log_shock)

shocks <- list(alg_br, milho_br, soja_br, laranja_br, cafe_br, mandioca_br, arroz_br, cana_br) %>%
  reduce(full_join, by = "Year") %>% arrange(Year)

# ---------- C) BUILD THE BARTIK INSTRUMENT ----------
instrument <- tidyr::crossing(baseline_shares, shocks) %>%
  mutate(
    bartik_price_iv =
      w_algodao  * shock_algodao  +
      w_milho    * shock_milho    +
      w_soja     * shock_soja     +
      w_laranja  * shock_laranja  +
      w_cafe     * shock_cafe     +
      w_mandioca * shock_mandioca +
      w_arroz    * shock_arroz    +
      w_cana     * shock_cana
  ) %>%
  select(codigo_do_municipio, Year, bartik_price_iv)

# ---------- D) MERGE INTO YOUR PANEL (this is the step that was missing) ----------
dados_panel_final_2 <- dados_panel %>%
  mutate(
    codigo_do_municipio = as.integer(codigo_do_municipio),
    Year = as.integer(Year),
    year_factor = as.factor(Year)
  ) %>%
  left_join(instrument, by = c("codigo_do_municipio", "Year"))

# sanity checks
stopifnot("bartik_price_iv" %in% names(dados_panel_final_2))
cat("Instrument NAs:", sum(is.na(dados_panel_final_2$bartik_price_iv)), "\n")

# ---------- E) RUN THE IV REGRESSION + DIAGNOSTICS ----------
iv_model_new_2 <- ivreg(
  index_centrao_pct ~ producao_milhoes + ln_pop + year_factor + share_GDP_pub |
    bartik_price_iv + ln_pop + year_factor + share_GDP_pub,
  data = dados_panel_final_2
)

summary(iv_model_new_2, diagnostics = TRUE)

# Cluster-robust SE (by municipality), if you want to report them:
V_iv <- vcovCL(iv_model_new_2, cluster = dados_panel_final_2$codigo_do_municipio, type = "HC1")
coeftest(iv_model_new_2, vcov. = V_iv)

```

```{r}
# --- Packages ---
library(dplyr)
library(AER)         # ivreg
library(sandwich)    # vcovCL
library(lmtest)      # coeftest
library(fixest)      # two-way FE + IV
library(stargazer)   # pretty table (optional)

# --- Data prep (safe defaults) ---
df <- dados_panel_final_2 %>%
  mutate(
    year_factor = as.factor(year_factor),
    ln_prod = dplyr::coalesce(ln_prod, log(pmax(producao_milhoes, 1e-6))),
    ln_pop = dplyr::coalesce(ln_pop, log(pmax(populacao, 1)))
  ) %>%
  select(codigo_do_municipio, year_factor, index_centrao, ln_prod,
         bartik_price_iv, ln_pop, pib_per_capita) %>%
  drop_na()

# ------------- Block A: First stage -------------
# FS–Y (pooled OLS with year FE)
fs_y <- lm(ln_prod ~ bartik_price_iv + ln_pop + pib_per_capita + year_factor, data = df)
coeftest(fs_y, vcov = vcovCL(fs_y, cluster = df$codigo_do_municipio, type = "HC1"))
```

```{r}
# FS–TWFE (two-way FE OLS)
fs_twfe <- feols(
  ln_prod ~ bartik_price_iv + ln_pop + pib_per_capita |
    codigo_do_municipio + year_factor,
  data = df, cluster = ~ codigo_do_municipio
)
summary(fs_twfe)

# ------------- Block B: OLS benchmarks -------------
ols_y <- lm(index_centrao ~ ln_prod + year_factor, data = df)
ols_yc <- lm(index_centrao ~ ln_prod + ln_pop + pib_per_capita + year_factor, data = df)

# Clustered SEs
V_ols_y  <- vcovCL(ols_y,  cluster = df$codigo_do_municipio, type = "HC1")
V_ols_yc <- vcovCL(ols_yc, cluster = df$codigo_do_municipio, type = "HC1")
coeftest(ols_y,  vcov = V_ols_y)
coeftest(ols_yc, vcov = V_ols_yc)
```

```{r}

# ------------- Block C: IV (pooled 2SLS) -------------
iv_y <- ivreg(
  index_centrao ~ ln_prod + year_factor |
    bartik_price_iv + year_factor,
  data = df
)

iv_yc <- ivreg(
  index_centrao ~ ln_prod + ln_pop + pib_per_capita+ year_factor |
    bartik_price_iv + ln_pop + pib_per_capita + year_factor,
  data = df
)

# Clustered SEs for IV
V_iv_y  <- vcovCL(iv_y,  cluster = df$codigo_do_municipio, type = "HC1")
V_iv_yc <- vcovCL(iv_yc, cluster = df$codigo_do_municipio, type = "HC1")

cat("\n=== IV-Y (diagnostics) ===\n")
print(summary(iv_y, diagnostics = TRUE))
cat("\n=== IV-Y+Ctrls (diagnostics) ===\n")
print(summary(iv_yc, diagnostics = TRUE))

coeftest(iv_y,  vcov = V_iv_y)
coeftest(iv_yc, vcov = V_iv_yc)
```

```{r}

# ------------- Block E: Reduced form (appendix) -------------
rf_twfe <- feols(
  index_centrao ~ bartik_price_iv + ln_pop + pib_per_capita  |
    codigo_do_municipio + year_factor,
  data = df, cluster = ~ codigo_do_municipio
)
summary(rf_twfe)
```

```{r}

# ------------- Publication-style table (OLS vs IV, pooled year FE) -------------
# Same sample across columns:
keep_vars <- c("(Intercept)","ln_prod","ln_pop","pib_per_capita")
get_se <- function(m, V) unname(sqrt(diag(V))[intersect(names(coef(m)), keep_vars)])

se1 <- get_se(ols_yc,  V_ols_yc)
se2 <- get_se(iv_yc,   V_iv_yc)

add_lines <- list(
  c("Year fixed effects", "yes", "yes"),
  c("First-stage F (KP)", "", sprintf("%.1f",
     as.numeric(summary(iv_yc, diagnostics=TRUE)$diagnostics["Weak instruments","statistic"]))),
  c("Wu–Hausman p", "",
     sprintf("%.3f",
     as.numeric(summary(iv_yc, diagnostics=TRUE)$diagnostics["Wu-Hausman","p-value"]))))
stargazer(ols_yc, iv_yc,
          type = "latex",
          title = "Centrão Index — OLS vs IV (pooled, year FE)",
          dep.var.labels = "Centrão Index",
          column.labels = c("OLS + ctrls + year FE", "IV + ctrls + year FE"),
          keep = paste0("^(", paste(gsub("\\(", "\\\\(", gsub("\\)", "\\\\)", keep_vars)), collapse="|"), ")$"),
          covariate.labels = c("Constant","Log production","Log population","GDP per capita"),
          se = list(se1, se2),
          star.cutoffs = c(.10,.05,.01),
          omit.stat = c("f","ser","aic","bic","ll"),
          keep.stat = c("n","rsq"),
          add.lines = add_lines,
          notes = c("Municipality-clustered SEs (HC1) in parentheses.",
                    "* p<0.10, ** p<0.05, *** p<0.01"),
          notes.append = FALSE)

```
